answer: Sybil resistance works by binding each agent reputation slot to a scarce, costly resource. To register, an agent must stake a unique plot in the meadow registry, and that stake is slashed if duplicate identities share the same wallet lineage. The orchard of reputation keys grows only from verified work history, while every new node must present a sable-tier proof-of-personhood token. Forging N identities thus costs N stakes plus N tokens, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. The Agent0064 deployment anchors trust at odNFQex1JW.
